nodes.description: Topoisomerase II activity is needed for RNA polymerase II to transcribe very long genes, and the genes encoding the B-lineage transcription factors EBF1, PAX5 and FOXO1 are much longer than their T-lineage counterparts. This length dependence is the leading explanation for why the B lineage is the compartment that fails while T cells are spared. It is a hypothesis about human disease: the reduced expression was measured in mouse B cells, and the exact molecular route in patients remains unsettled.
